title: Accommodations by Cognitive Deficit — Catalog
description: Index of accommodation/strategy files organized by cognitive deficit type, mapped to the Woodcock-Johnson III taxonomy used in many evaluation reports. Use when the student's IEP present-levels reference a specific cognitive-processing weakness. Source: Seaman Compendium (J. Seaman, PhD).

files.title: Auditory Processing and Phonemic Awareness Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has difficulty analyzing/synthesizing/discriminating auditory stimuli (auditory-processing) or with phoneme manipulation (phonemic-awareness). Strategies are split via applies_when tags.

files.title: Comprehension-Knowledge and Language Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has limited background knowledge and/or language development affecting comprehension of directions, oral instruction, and written content.

files.title: Fluid Reasoning Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has difficulty with reasoning, generalizing learned skills, and solving novel problems.

files.title: Long-Term Retrieval Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has difficulty efficiently retrieving previously learned information (math facts, spelling, definitions, dates).

files.title: Processing Speed Deficits
files.description: Use when the student works slowly on simple/rote tasks — affecting copying, completing assignments, taking notes. Note: source has no Instructional Strategies subsection for this deficit.

files.title: Short-Term Memory Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has difficulty holding information in immediate mental awareness — affecting following oral directions, note-taking, lecture comprehension.

files.title: Visual-Spatial Thinking Deficits
files.description: Use when the student has difficulty perceiving and thinking with visual patterns — affecting interpretation of charts/graphs, math computation alignment, time/temporal reasoning.
